caption: A mountain stands beside a still lake at dawn, and an upside-down image of the mountain lies on the water.

sa.check: A mountain stands beside a lake.
An upside-down image of the mountain lies on the water.

pc.expect: The image is inverted, its peak pointing downward, and meets the real mountain at the shoreline.
pc.fail: The image is upright; or it is offset from the shoreline; or it is a different mountain's outline.

pc.expect: The image blurs where the surface is disturbed and is sharp where the water is still.
pc.fail: It stays sharp across plain ripples; or blurs on a glassy surface; or it is missing on still water.

pc.expect: The image does not move with the mountain and water still.
pc.fail: It drifts across the lake; or shifts while the surface is calm; or the mountain moves.

pc.expect: The image has the mountain's colours, slightly dimmer.
pc.fail: It is a different colour; or brighter than the mountain; or it changes colour on its own.

pc.expect: One mountain and one reflection of it; the reflection stays on the water.
pc.fail: A second mountain appears; or the reflection rises off the water; or the mountain vanishes; or the reflection becomes solid.

pc.expect: The sky, the shore and the mountain stay the same.
pc.fail: The sky changes colour abruptly; or the shore rearranges; or the mountain changes shape.
